title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
summary: Autonomous medical robots hold promise to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider workload, democratize access to care, and enable superhuman precision. However, autonomous medical robotics has been limited by a fundamental data problem: existing medical robotic datasets are small, single-embodiment, and rarely shared openly, restricting the development of foundation models that the field needs to advance. We introduce Open-H-Embodiment, the largest open dataset of medical robotic video with synchronized kinematics to date, spanning more than 49 institutions and multiple robotic platforms including the CMR Versius, Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci, da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), Rob Surgical BiTrack, Virtual Incision's MIRA, Moon Surgical Maestro, and a variety of custom systems, spanning surgical manipulation, robotic ultrasound, and endoscopy procedures. We demonstrate the research enabled by this dataset through two foundation models. GR00T-H is the first open foundation vision-language-action model for medical robotics, which is the only evaluated model to achieve full end-to-end task completion on a structured suturing benchmark (25% of trials vs. 0% for all others) and achieves 64% average success across a 29-step ex vivo suturing sequence. We also train Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, the first action-conditioned world model to enable multi-embodiment surgical simulation from a single checkpoint, spanning nine robotic platforms and supporting in silico policy evaluation and synthetic data generation for the medical domain. These results suggest that open, large-scale medical robot data collection can serve as critical infrastructure for the research community, enabling advances in robot learning, world modeling, and beyond.
tldr: Open-H-Embodiment is the largest open dataset of medical robotic video with synchronized kinematics, spanning over 49 institutions and multiple robotic platforms, and it enables the first open vision-language-action model (GR00T-H) and the first action-conditioned world model (Cosmos-H) for multi-embodiment surgical simulation.
tldr_zh: Open-H-Embodiment是目前规模最大的开放医学机器人视频数据集，包含同步运动学数据，涵盖49余家机构和多种机器人平台，并支撑了首个开放的视觉-语言-动作模型GR00T-H以及首个动作条件的跨平台手术模拟世界模型Cosmos-H。
summary_zh: 自主医疗机器人有望改善患者预后、减轻医护人员负担、普及医疗服务并实现超越人类的精度。然而，自动医疗机器人技术一直受到一个根本性数据问题的制约：现有的医疗机器人数据集规模小、单一机器人形态、且很少公开共享，限制了领域发展所需的基础模型的开发。我们推出Open-H-Embodiment，这是迄今为止规模最大的医疗机器人视频同步运动学公开数据集，涵盖49家机构和多个机器人平台，包括CMR Versius、Intuitive Surgical的da Vinci、da Vinci研究套件（dVRK）、Rob Surgical BiTrack、Virtual Incision的MIRA、Moon Surgical Maestro以及各种定制系统，涵盖手术操作、机器人超声和内镜检查程序。我们通过两个基础模型展示了该数据集所支持的研究。GR00T-H是首个用于医疗机器人的开源基础视觉-语言-动作模型，也是唯一在结构化缝合基准测试中实现完整端到端任务完成的评估模型（25%的试验成功率，而其他所有模型均为0%），并在29步体外缝合序列中达到64%的平均成功率。我们还训练了Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator，这是首个动作条件的世界模型，能够从单一检查点实现多机器人形态的外科模拟，涵盖九个机器人平台，并支持医疗领域的虚拟策略评估和合成数据生成。这些结果表明，开放、大规模的医疗机器人数据收集可以作为研究界的关键基础设施，推动机器人学习、世界建模等领域的发展。

title: Divide-then-Diagnose: Weaving Clinician-Inspired Contexts for Ultra-Long Capsule Endoscopy Videos
summary: Capsule endoscopy (CE) enables non-invasive gastrointestinal screening, but current CE research remains largely limited to frame-level classification and detection, leaving video-level analysis underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce and formally define a new task, diagnosis-driven CE video summarization, which requires extracting key evidence frames that covers clinically meaningful findings and making accurate diagnoses from those evidence frames. This setting is challenging because diagnostically relevant events are extremely sparse and can be overwhelmed by tens of thousands of redundant normal frames, while individual observations are often ambiguous due to motion blur, debris, specular highlights, and rapid viewpoint changes. To facilitate research in this direction, we introduce VideoCAP, the first CE dataset with diagnosis-driven annotations derived from real clinical reports. VideoCAP comprises 240 full-length videos and provides realistic supervision for both key evidence frame extraction and diagnosis. To address this task, we further propose DiCE, a clinician-inspired framework that mirrors the standard CE reading workflow. DiCE first performs efficient candidate screening over the raw video, then uses a Context Weaver to organize candidates into coherent diagnostic contexts that preserve distinct lesion events, and an Evidence Converger to aggregate multi-frame evidence within each context into robust clip-level judgments. Experiments show that DiCE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, producing concise and clinically reliable diagnostic summaries. These results highlight diagnosis-driven contextual reasoning as a promising paradigm for ultra-long CE video summarization.
tldr: The paper introduces a diagnosis-driven capsule endoscopy video summarization task, a new dataset (VideoCAP) with real clinical reports, and a clinician-inspired framework (DiCE) that extracts key evidence frames to produce accurate diagnostic summaries for ultra‑long CE videos.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了诊断驱动的胶囊内镜视频摘要任务，构建了首个带有真实临床报告标注的VideoCAP数据集，并设计了Divide‑then‑Diagnose（DiCE）框架，以从超长胶囊内镜视频中提取关键证据帧并给出准确诊断。
summary_zh: 胶囊内镜（CE）能够实现无创胃肠道筛查，但当前CE研究仍主要局限于帧级分类和检测，视频级分析仍未得到充分探索。为弥补这一空白，我们引入并正式定义了一个新任务——诊断驱动的CE视频摘要，该任务要求提取覆盖临床有意义发现的关键证据帧，并基于这些证据帧做出准确诊断。这一设置具有挑战性，因为诊断相关事件极为稀疏，可能被数以万计的冗余正常帧所淹没，而单个观察结果常因运动模糊、碎屑、镜面高光和快速视角变化而难以确定。为推动这一方向的研究，我们引入了VideoCAP，这是首个基于真实临床报告构建诊断驱动标注的CE数据集。VideoCAP包含240个完整视频，并为关键证据帧提取和诊断提供了真实监督。为解决这一任务，我们进一步提出了DiCE，一个临床启发的框架，遵循标准CE阅片工作流程。DiCE首先对原始视频进行高效候选筛选，然后使用上下文编织器将候选组织成连贯的诊断上下文以保留不同的病变事件，并使用证据聚合器在每个上下文内聚合多帧证据形成稳健的片段级判断。实验表明，DiCE始终优于最先进的方法，产生简洁且临床可靠的诊断摘要。这些结果凸显了诊断驱动的上下文推理作为超长CE视频摘要的一种有前景范式的潜力。
